name: apimatic
description: APIMatic plugin marketplace — SDK-native, version-aware API context for your AI coding agent.

plugins.name: context-matic
plugins.description: Deterministic, version-aware API and SDK context for third-party APIs, delivered directly into your coding agent.

plugins.name: acp-paypal
plugins.description: Integrate and debug PayPal APIs using the acp-paypal MCP server.

plugins.name: maxio-sdk
plugins.description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. A single maxio-sdk agent plans a map-grounded contract sheet, answers narrow contract questions, and fixes SDK compile/build errors in place — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the integrate-maxio router + the maxio-sdk agent. No MCP server. (Do not install alongside maxio-sdk-clone — they share skill/agent names.)
